variants: A rival drive matched your vector for a stretch — same corridor, no hail, no contact.
Another hull was working this route. Both of you kept your distances.
A strange signature shadowed you for a while, then peeled away without a word.
Another pilot shared the lane. You nodded over the radio; nobody wanted trouble.
Two ships, one corridor, one unspoken truce — you passed each other and kept going.
A contact paced you at the edge of the scope, then took the next fork and was gone.
